subject: A quick reminder about bill B100057
body:
Hi Arjun,

We noticed your bill B100057 for $108.45, due on 2026-11-08, has not been paid yet. It may simply have slipped through. Please pay when you can, or reply if you need any help.

Warm regards,
The Your Telco Team

If you have already paid, please ignore this message. If you think this bill is incorrect, you can raise a dispute or get help any time by replying to this email or writing to support@yourtelco.example.
